title: Ropelength-Filtered Knot Densities
summary: We study scale-invariant $p$-densities of knot types in Euclidean three-space, defined as the infimum over representatives of the length divided by an $L^p$-type mean of the pairwise chord lengths; the exponent $p$ is any value greater than minus one, including infinity, where the mean is the diameter. The unconstrained density is independent of the knot type.
